faqSchema.source:
A few weeks for most people. Speech and eating both improve with practice. Reading aloud at home is the fastest way to sort out speech.

A well-made partial denture is designed to be discreet. Metal clasps are placed as unobtrusively as possible, and tooth shade and shape are matched to your own at the try-in.

Yes, in almost all cases. Leaving it in overnight means the gum tissue never rests and raises the risk of fungal infection.

Several years is typical, but the gum and bone underneath change shape over time, so it will need relining or eventually remaking. Regular reviews pick that up before it becomes a problem.

Often yes, particularly with acrylic dentures. Cobalt-chrome frameworks are less straightforward to add to but can sometimes be modified. We will advise at the time.

Possibly. Whether implants are suitable depends on bone volume, gum health, general health and cost. Dr Meg places implants and can assess whether they are a realistic option for you.

fields.label: Main heading
fields.value: Replacing several teeth without surgery.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: A partial denture replaces missing teeth with a removable appliance that clips around the teeth you still have. It restores chewing, supports the lips and cheeks, fills visible gaps, and stops remaining teeth drifting into the space.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: It is the practical option where several teeth are missing, where the gaps are spread around the mouth, or where implants or bridges are not suitable — because of bone volume, general health, or cost.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: Full dentures are not currently provided at Lava Street Dental. Where you need a full denture, we will refer you.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Types

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Acrylic partial dentures have a plastic base and are generally the more economical option. They are also the usual choice as an immediate or interim denture while tissues heal after extractions, since they are simpler to adjust and add to.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Cobalt-chrome partial dentures have a cast metal framework. They are thinner, stronger, and can be designed to take support from the remaining teeth rather than resting entirely on the gum, which is generally more comfortable and kinder to the tissues over time. They cost more and are the usual recommendation for a long-term denture.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Dr Meg will explain which is appropriate for your situation and why, along with the cost of each.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: What is involved

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Making a partial denture takes several appointments, because each stage builds on the last. Records are taken — usually a digital scan, sometimes a conventional impression where that gives a better result — then the bite is recorded, then a try-in stage lets you see the tooth position and shade before anything is finalised. The finished denture is then fitted and adjusted.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The try-in matters. It is where the appearance is agreed, and it is far easier to change tooth position at that stage than after the denture is processed.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Settling in

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A new partial denture takes getting used to. Expect it to feel bulky for the first week or two, expect speech to need practice, and expect to start with softer food cut small before working up. Increased saliva at first is normal.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Sore spots are also normal and are the reason review appointments are scheduled. Do not endure a rubbing denture and do not adjust it yourself — bring it in, wear it for a few hours before the appointment so the sore spot is visible, and we will relieve it.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Clean the denture over a basin of water or a folded towel so it survives being dropped. Brush it daily with a denture brush and mild soap rather than toothpaste, which is abrasive. Leave it out overnight and store it in water so the tissues get a rest.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Keep seeing us regularly. The teeth holding the denture in place carry extra load and need watching, and the gum underneath changes shape over the years, so the fit needs reviewing.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently asked questions

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: How long will it take to get used to?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A few weeks for most people. Speech and eating both improve with practice. Reading aloud at home is the fastest way to sort out speech.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Will people notice I am wearing it?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A well-made partial denture is designed to be discreet. Metal clasps are placed as unobtrusively as possible, and tooth shade and shape are matched to your own at the try-in.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Do I have to take it out at night?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes, in almost all cases. Leaving it in overnight means the gum tissue never rests and raises the risk of fungal infection.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: How long does a partial denture last?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Several years is typical, but the gum and bone underneath change shape over time, so it will need relining or eventually remaking. Regular reviews pick that up before it becomes a problem.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Can teeth be added if I lose another one?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Often yes, particularly with acrylic dentures. Cobalt-chrome frameworks are less straightforward to add to but can sometimes be modified. We will advise at the time.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Can I get implants instead?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Possibly. Whether implants are suitable depends on bone volume, gum health, general health and cost. Dr Meg places implants and can assess whether they are a realistic option for you.
